expectations.text: Activity: escalation has its own timeline — portents advance whether the party is present or not
expectations.evidence: Line 63: 'The Dead Lady moves on an independent schedule, hitting ports roughly every 1-3 days.' Lines 105-111: explicit circuit schedule (Days 1-2 La Vasca→Kalowe, Days 3-4 Kalowe→Marlstrand, etc.). The circuit runs regardless of party location.

expectations.text: Early arrival produces different situation than mid or late arrival
expectations.evidence: Lines 65-69: Three distinct encounter states based on timing: 'Recent strike' (party finds fresh wreckage), 'Approaching storm' (warnings of red-hulled ship ahead), 'Dead calm after the wake' (empty docks, diverted traffic, survivors being tended). Arrival timing changes what the party finds.

expectations.text: Tide driven by Umberlee's established want and constraints, not by party arrival
expectations.evidence: Line 65: 'The party's arrival at a Midchain port is coincidental with the Dead Lady's circuit, not the trigger for it.' Umberlee's want (Pearl returned) drives the collection circuit. The Dead Lady operates on Umberlee's schedule.

expectations.text: Causality: each portent follows from the prior through Umberlee's methods (weather, Dead Lady, Waveservants)
expectations.evidence: Portent 1: evidence surfaces (Days 2-5). Portent 2: weather shifts (Days 10-14). Portent 3: Delmar cornered (Days 20+). Each uses Umberlee's methods with explicit fictional triggers.

expectations.text: Quest frame names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Delmar's defiance vs Umberlee's demand for the Pearl. Live pressure: Dead Lady's active collection circuit. Uninterrupted consequence: 'Trade disruption worsens over weeks... escalation does not depend on party presence.'

expectations.text: Does not make the Dead Lady appear only upon party arrival at a port
expectations.evidence: Line 65: 'The party's arrival at a Midchain port is coincidental with the Dead Lady's circuit, not the trigger for it.' Explicit conversion of the frozen-island pattern to an independent timeline.
